lineage.reuse: Reuse AO/O/T/AN original base weights only by exact raw SHA. Keep AP fixed, archive all negatives. Do not reuse consumed prior TRAIN as new source.

fresh_source.structure: Reuse the unchanged AP original paired first-admitted graph birth, original four families, 24 matched noisy public supports and 3 erroneous output bits. Forty-eight positive/negative pairs per lane/split.
fresh_source.source_birth_rule: First freeze this record in immutable Git commit. Source adapter rejects DEV entirely until separately admitted DEV first-use. No source truth, operator name, oracle, partner graph label or inverse available to candidate.

Yggdrasil.hypothesis: A learned compositional inverse from noisy demonstrations, assembled out of reusable Boolean parity and pair-conjunction features, can extract causal relation structure that ridge kernels and low-depth trees fail to identify.
Yggdrasil.learn: For each of 16 inverse output-bit targets, greedily fit a parity of observed output bits or observed conjunction features to the 20 public supervised pairs, using deterministic bitset residual updates and a learned bias. No semantic operation catalog, family or inverse oracle. For the nonlinear arm, include pairwise AND feature atoms without a source-defined Feistel rule.
Yggdrasil.train_selection: Exactly 18 candidate configurations; source-blind TRAIN paired label outcomes only. First prefer zero FP, then maximize paired accuracy, minimize FN and declared work, stable lexical tie-break. No operator truth used in optimizer.
Yggdrasil.capacity: Yggdrasil graph transition stage remains 7 active and 9 retained cognitive cells; per-task parity coefficient table and full transient atom/bitset fit are separate disclosed inference-memory costs. Never claim strict 16-cell end-to-end storage parity.
Yggdrasil.eligibility_for_first_dev: New TRAIN candidate must have meaningful paired correct sensitivity (>0) and zero FP, beat all eligible prior learned TRAIN control on exactly the same new cohort, with independent source and memory qualification. If not, record negative TRAIN and preserve DEV.

Wingless.hypothesis: Per-hop relative causal contrast against locally competing paths or competing lookahead handoffs can reject false paths while preserving positive long chains in one original 12-bit packed state/node.
Wingless.train_selection: All gamma0-positive long cases must remain individually positive for a new candidate; then maximize paired score, minimize FP and additional measured work, prefer original on tie.
Wingless.strict_dev: Only if fresh TRAIN candidate strictly lowers false positives with all original long positives individually retained, and zero extra persistent node/path state. Source-only normalized all arms equally.

stages: focused Windows+Linux source tests including historical AP isolation
authenticated raw historical foundation + current TRAIN screening
exactly one final integrated Go test/race/vet/build/isolation regression
qualification.guardrails: No protected first-use, no optimizer or scientific promotion, no merges or production changes; no paid API or new scheduler; preserve negative evidence and no DEV optimization.
